metadata.description: Curated Claude Code skills + the skill-detectors framework. Plugins use commit-SHA versioning, so every push refreshes consumers on next session start.

plugins.name: skill-detectors
plugins.description: Two-leg framework that surfaces context-conditional skills automatically. SessionStart hook watches disk state and emits SKILL_SIGNAL markers (offer/route/constrain). UserPromptSubmit hook watches chat content and emits SKILL_SIGNAL_CANDIDATE markers when the user mentions something that may warrant a new detector. Solves the 'I installed it but always forget to invoke it' problem for context-conditional tools.

plugins.name: catalog
plugins.description: Index of every skill available in this marketplace. Install on every machine — even machines that don't have all plugins installed will know what's available, so Claude can suggest installing on demand.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Project-agnostic workflow skills: structured development lifecycle, PRD-driven autonomous builds, eval testing, persona switching, multi-step planning, brainstorming, and full-stack app orchestration from natural-language input.

plugins.name: frontend
plugins.description: Frontend stack: React + Next.js, TypeScript-based component patterns, Tailwind v4, design systems / UI design tokens, mobile-first design, browser automation, theme application, accessibility/WIG compliance, and text-aware layout via pretext.

plugins.name: backend
plugins.description: Backend: Node.js/Express/TypeScript microservices with layered architecture, schema design, third-party API integration, type-level TypeScript, JavaScript fundamentals, Bun runtime.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: CI/CD, containerization, deployment, GitHub workflow automation, shell scripting. Includes Docker (multi-stage builds, hardening, Compose), Vercel + Next.js deployment, and Bash/Linux terminal patterns.

plugins.name: claude-stack
plugins.description: Anthropic ecosystem + cross-model tools: Claude API / Agent SDK app development (with prompt caching), MCP server building, Gemini CLI for large-context review, parallel Gemini + Codex cross-validation (multi-ai-review), and a bundled monthly-refreshed LLM API pricing reference (llm-api-pricing).

plugins.name: ai-agents
plugins.description: Building autonomous AI agents: architecture, tool integration, persistent memory systems, multi-agent orchestration / computer-use patterns, local CLI agent management, refactoring bloated AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files, and WALT (Salesforce) for auto-discovering reusable browser-automation tools from any website.

plugins.name: ai-ml
plugins.description: LangChain for LLM-powered apps: agents, chains, RAG, 500+ integrations across providers (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google), tool calling, memory management, vector stores.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Code review and security: code quality (refactoring, coding standards, smells), security review (auth, input validation, secrets, vulnerabilities, deployment checklist), security audit (secrets, permissions, ports, DB integrity).

plugins.name: content
plugins.description: Content + document tools: PDF manipulation (extract, create, merge, forms), document-grounded analysis on local files (notebook, NotebookLM-style FTS5+MCP) or Google NotebookLM (browser-driven), and meme generation via memegen.link.

plugins.name: business
plugins.description: Business / go-to-market: CEO advisory and strategy, marketing ideas (140 SaaS marketing approaches), App Store Optimization, UX research (interviews, personas, journey mapping), email systems (deliverability, automation, transactional).

plugins.name: automation
plugins.description: Cross-tool workflow automation: Jira issue/sprint/backlog management, configurable metric watchers with alerts (URLs, shell commands, latency), and Zapier orchestration via MCP + webhooks.

plugins.name: wordpress
plugins.description: Comprehensive WordPress development: block themes + Site Editor, custom blocks (apiVersion 3, Block Bindings, Pattern Overrides, Section Styles), plugin architecture, REST API with schema, Interactivity API (store/state), performance, security, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), wp.org compliance, wp-env + wp-scripts.

plugins.name: skill-management
plugins.description: Discover, create, and propagate Claude Code skills: find-skills (search/install from ecosystem), skill-development (full TDD lifecycle), skill-enhance (propagate a tech across your library).
